must: Tailoring depth may vary by risk, but requirement/scope/acceptance correctness, traceability, blocking open items and gates, risk-matched verification/evidence, authority boundaries, required human collaboration, deviation correction, and Git-fixed Task Commit/code_ref remain preserved.

source.anchor: ## Human / Agent Authority｜人机决策权限

must: Requirement semantics, In/Out Scope, core business rules, Acceptance Criteria semantic changes, Accepted Deviation, risk acceptance, and mandatory-gate waivers remain Human Decision matters.

when: A Shared Model, Meaningful Model Delta, Decision Boundary, Authority Escalation, Shared Model Invalidated, or Major Closure trigger occurs.
must: Synchronize only the decision-relevant cognitive delta before the dependent Human decision.

when: An important Confirm, Human Decision, or Human Acceptance is about to occur.
must: Ensure Human has the minimum sufficient goal, current model, delta/finding, evidence, options/consequences when real alternatives exist, recommendation, and remaining uncertainty before requesting the decision.
Main Agent retains global coherence and final accountability.
must_not: Subagent independently changes Requirement, Acceptance Criteria, Scope, fixed Design Decision, Formal Task Goal/Boundary/Coverage/Verification/Done, Workflow State, Accepted Deviation, or risk acceptance.

must: At any one shared mutable boundary, allow only one Worker owner at a time.
Derive Runnable only when dependencies are satisfied, no valid blocker exists, and the required execution environment is available.
must_not: Persist Runnable, Queued, or Scheduled as Task states.

when: Task is Runnable and its Execution Unit is ready.
must: Claim the Task and transition Ready → In Progress before Worker execution.
Worker may choose implementation strategy and local repair within the Task Contract.
must_not: Worker silently changes Requirement/Acceptance Criteria, fixed Design Decision, Task Goal/Boundary/Coverage, or Verification Contract.

source.anchor: ## 2.5 Task Commit 与送验证收敛

when: Necessary Local Verification has passed and a Git-fixed change exists.
must: Create a scoped Task Commit with stable code_ref before entering formal Verification.
Verification-ready Result records Task, Requirement, actual changes, achieved result, local evidence, code_ref when Git-fixed change exists, and only relevant verification notes.
must_not: Treat Task Commit as Task Done, Requirement Integration, Merge, Release, or deployment.

source.anchor: ## 3.3 执行独立验证与质量门禁

must: Run deterministic Gate first against the actual verification object and exact code_ref when one exists.
must_not: Treat Worker self-verification as formal proof.

source.anchor: ## 3.3 执行独立验证与质量门禁

when: Complex semantic/quality/UX questions or high-risk changes need independent reasoning beyond deterministic Gate.
must: Use a fresh Reviewer with context isolated from Worker where practical and sufficient capability for the review.
must_not: Let Reviewer replace deterministic Gate or default to repairing the implementation.

when: A formal failure cannot be reliably attributed, needs cross-layer localization, or evidence cannot identify the earliest failed layer.
must: Enter Debug & Defect Resolution instead of guessing.
Map passed → Done, repair_required → In Progress, and blocked → Blocked as the target Task status.
Write the Verification verdict to the authoritative Task state and preserve confirmed Result/Evidence/code_ref or Blocker facts.
must_not: Persist Worker logs, intermediate reasoning, or short-lived Agent/Model/Workspace metadata as Task facts.

must: Perform Requirement Integration, then Requirement AC Gate, and only after it passes perform Requirement Push.
must_not: Treat Requirement Push as Merge, Release, Deploy, or Stage 6 final Verified.
